findings.title: Ranking dispatches governed inputs after source withdrawal during admission contention

rules.quote: Source permissions, expiry and withdrawal are evaluated at each use.

rules.description: Governed assessed inputs share candidate support dependencies and current-policy support.

findings.fix: Inject an owner-provided exact governed-input source/derivation guard into shared admission; keep source locks through dispatch commit.

findings.title: Alert context and monitoring promotion acquire owner locks in opposite order

rules.quote: The operation holds the public knowledge publication frontier lock, then the recent owner's policy/window lock
Acquire the knowledge frontier before recent policy locks; retain both through all local effects/receipt commit.
Make contracts, invariants, side effects, and failure behavior explicit.
Handle errors at the right boundary with useful context.

findings.coordination: A separate advisory gate pauses investigate after it owns recent policy and before KB search. Promote then owns the frontier and waits for recent. Releasing the gate creates the actual public-operation cycle; PostgreSQL blocking metadata coordinates without business-state SQL assertions.
findings.fix: Use one consistent public owner lock order for context selection and promotion; retain existing atomic local commit and no-I/O boundaries.

findings.title: Quantitative alert read returns nested source evidence without process permission

rules.quote: Display current counts and evidence only from the exact original windows with current process/display/retention permission.

rules.description: Current numerical claims and evidence use exact windows with current process/display/retention permission.

findings.scope_note: RecentMonitoring purpose-specific display semantics remain valid for independent source views. The documented alert-owner projection is stricter.
findings.fix: Apply the alert full-permission overlay to returned nested windows and their alert HTTP rendering.

findings.baseline: The same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file; extract the shared shape and call it from both.
findings.impact: Strict message/content/refusal/JSON envelope validation has two implementations that must track one contract.
findings.fix: Call public responses.generated_document and preserve criteria-specific refusal status mapping.
